items.text: My motivation for assembling this cookbook was primarily my two
daughters. Although I cooked when they were young girls, I did
not cook at home much when they were in their teenage years and
beyond. Thus, they did not learn to cook from me. I can’t say that
they ever seemed interested, but I definitely did not give them much
opportunity. Schedules were busy, and it seemed to be much easier
to eat as we could fit it into our schedules and help the restaurant
When I did cook, I cooked “big,” and everyone enjoyed what I
cooked. My husband often teased me about my “great
collection, however, was scattered everywhere: on scraps of paper,
napkins, recipe cards, cookbooks, and magazines with “dog
pages. I usually had to go into major search mode to locate the
So, I decided to assemble everything together in one place
that was organized, alphabetized, and easy to find. I have included
recipes from more than 35 years of collecting. There are recipes from
my grandmother, my mother, my mother
my daughters, my aunts, my nieces, and my friends. Then there are
some recipes that I have meant to try for a long time, but I never
I would like to thank my daughter, Jenn, who has done the artistic
part of the cookbook. I would also like to thank all who have
shared recipes with me over the years and those who have submitted
recipes specifically for this cookbook. I hope you enjoy my collection
of family favorites and that you actually take the time to make
something from it. At least I will now know exactly where to find
my recipes when I do become inspired to cook.
